# Refresh Renovation — Avatar card v0

**Status:** v0, draft. Built from one interview. Confirm with more franchisee interviews (and John English) before it becomes v1. Needs Adam's approval.
**Avatar type:** business builder / management franchise (~£35k). Tight avatar.
**Target:** ~£4,000 per signed franchisee (one a month on ~£4k/month).
**Source:** Adam's interview with Ali Irteza, 4 Nov 2026 (Downloads\2026-11-04_1100_Adam_45_Mins_transcript.txt). The transcript is auto-generated, so figures are approximate.

## Reference franchisee: Ali Irteza (London, since 2022)
- Ex-**global sales director** (telecoms) until 2020. Set up a **logistics business** in 2020 (still running). **No construction background.**
- **Trigger:** Covid → went it alone. A bad experience with his own home renovation → "I can sell the solution to this."
- Rough results (his words, unchecked): first project month 5–6; ~£100k year 1, ~£250k year 2, growing since. Jobs £15k–£400k; ~9% net margin. Aims for £3m+ in five years.
- Leads: home exhibitions (~70% for him), Google Ads, referrals (~30% over time), BNI.
- Scaling bottleneck: project managers and costing (QS), not demand.

## What he says makes a franchisee succeed
1. **Knows how to run a business:** cash flow, VAT, CIS, a good construction accountant
2. **Builds a team, doesn't do the work:** qualified project managers for quality assurance; good sub-trades
3. **Never stops marketing:** consistent lead flow
4. **Genuine love of property:** landlord, own renovation, interest in design
5. **6–12 months of money to live on**
6. **Resilience and a growth mindset:** calm under pressure, buys into the vision

## Draft qualifiers (3–5)
1. Has **run a business, or managed teams or budgets** at a senior level
2. Has **the investment plus 6–12 months of living costs**
3. Wants to **build a company with a team** (not work on the tools)
4. Has a **genuine connection to property** (landlord, own renovation, design)
5. **Wants to start soon** (universal qualifier)

## Anti-avatar
- Ex-builders/tradespeople who can't run a business
- First-time business owners expecting hand-holding (two of Ali's contacts struggled; one almost dormant)
- People who won't invest in marketing ("one lead in four weeks")
- Negative, not growth-oriented

## Triggers to record (not qualifiers)
Covid, redundancy, leaving a 9–5, a bad renovation experience of their own.

## Form questions this suggests (Stage A, no filtering yet)
- When would you like to start?
- Have you run a business, or managed a team or budget? (options)
- Do you have [investment] plus 6 months of living costs available? (options)
- Do you want to build a team, or do the work yourself?
- What's your connection to property? (landlord / renovated my own home / interest in design / none)
- What do you do now? (role and level)

## Objections to prepare for (not for marketing)
- **Support:** Ali felt guidance on local marketing channels and pricing was thin, and hand-holding was reduced after he joined. John and Mike need strong answers. Useful feedback for John.
- **Time to first project:** Ali says it should be within 3 months with the right local guidance.
- **Delivery quality / sub-trades** without a construction background.

## Content ideas
- **Ali as a testimonial** (with consent): sales director, no building background, now running a growing company
- His client insight: "busy professionals who've never renovated are perfect clients"
- "First project within 3 months" (once checked)

## Path v1
VSL → prospectus → call → next steps → questions (Adam's known path), plus avatar testimonials. To be refined from tracking.
